description:
Convert GeoJSON to a MapInfo TAB file set, ready for MapInfo Pro.
    TAB is a multi-sidecar-file format (.tab/.dat/.id/.map) and single
    geometry type per file, like Shapefile — always returned as a zip,
    mixed point/line/polygon input is split into one .tab set per category.

    Returns JSON: {mapinfo_tab_zip_base64: str, split: bool,
    split_categories: [str]|null}.
name: geojson_to_mapinfo_tab
